answer: Fund-lineage pricing: each new agent identity must burn a fee, and the price doubles for every identity already seeded from the same funding lineage, traced like a saffron thread through coin ancestry. One honest agent pays a trivial fee; an attacker spawning 1,000 fakes from one treasury pays 2^1000, so splitting funds becomes the giveaway signal. Laundering through mixers costs time and fees, stacking up like timber.
